name: Summit Shores Advisors (Partner)
link: Email Cover Letter and Resume to Christina Poole-Bonacic
desc:
Field Insurance Agent (Medicare, ACA, Life & Final Expense) | Requires Life & Health Insurance License | 1099 not standard telesales
Company: Summit Shores Advisors, housed under Excel Financial, contracted through AmeriLife (FMO)
Position Type: 1099 Independent Contractor, LOA (Licensed Only Agent)
Work Style: Hybrid. You'll work from home setting up leads and making calls, and meet clients in person at their home, a coffee shop, a library, or wherever they're comfortable.
What Your Day Will Look Like
 You'll build your own Medicare, ACA, life, and final expense book of business using a mix of free outbound leads (provided at no cost for your first six months), organic lead generation (doctor's office visits, booths, educational events), and optional purchased leads if you want them. You'll set your own appointments and meet clients however works best for them, in person or by phone. You'll have access to a full training library built for self-paced learning, plus live support sessions multiple times a day and workshops with outside experts (annuity specialists, tax experts, and more).
Pay Structure
You have two payment paths once you're contracted and start writing business:
Direct to Carrier: You're paid directly by the insurance carrier under standard commission structure once you're eligible.
Financial Partnership (Advance Option): Through Excel Financial, you get $250 paid two weeks after you write an enrollment, plus ongoing annual renewals as long as that policy stays on your book of business. If you choose this option, you commit to staying on it for one year. Most new agents will likely start here since it gets money moving faster while they build their book. ($250 for each enrollment plus residuals)
Costs to the Agent
Phone system: $35/month (deducted from pay)
E&O (Errors and Omissions) insurance: agent's responsibility, though the company will help cover the first two to three months of E&O if working a border state (approx $35/yr)
Purchased leads (optional): pre-scheduled appointments available at $100 each if the agent chooses to buy them, industry standard rate
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education: None required
You must hold a valid Oklahoma Insurance Producer license in Life and Health
Some sales experience is helpful but not required
You'll need to pass a background check
No drug test required
Equipment is not provided, but the software and platform access are
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:

Email your resume to Christina. 
Expect a phone call and an email. 
 no assessment, no interview
other:
Best Fit For
 Participants who are self-motivated, comfortable working independently with minimal oversight, have enough financial stability to get through the ramp-up period, and want to build something long-term rather than just land a job. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building instincts matter more than prior sales experience.
Not a Good Fit For
 Participants who need immediate, predictable income right away, need structure and daily direction to stay on task, or are not yet licensed in Life and Health.
Hiring Process
 No formal interview since this is a 1099 role. Instead, candidates have a phone call with the team leader to review expectations and duties, followed by unpaid training to get started.
